name: Portal Scroll
description: Opens a portal back to town.

name: Orb of Transmutation
description: Upgrades a normal item to a magic item.

name: Orb of Augmentation
description: Enchants a magic item with a new random modifier.

name: Orb of Alteration
description: Reforges a magic item with new random modifiers.

name: Regal Orb
description: Upgrades a magic item to a rare item, adding one modifier.

name: Orb of Alchemy
description: Upgrades a normal item to a rare item with 4-6 random modifiers.

name: Chaos Orb
description: Reforges a rare item with new random modifiers.

name: Exalted Orb
description: Enchants a rare item with a new random modifier.

name: Divine Orb
description: Randomises the numeric values of all random modifiers on an item.

name: Orb of Scouring
description: Removes all modifiers from an item, returning it to normal.

name: Jeweller's Orb
description: Expands the number of support slots on an Active Gem (up to 5 slots).

name: Chromatic Orb
description: Reforges the attribute alignment of support slots on an Active Gem.

name: Orb of Regret
description: Grants one passive skill respec point.

name: Vaal Orb
description: Corrupts an item or gem, modifying it unpredictably.

name: Mirror of Kalandra
description: Creates a mirrored, unmodifiable duplicate of a non-unique item.
